batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b Avesh Khan

batting.name: RA Tripathi
batting.dismissal: c Lalit Yadav b MP Stoinis

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b Lalit Yadav

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c Shivam Mavi b PJ Cummins

balls.text: 141ks full-toss outside off as the attempted yorker goes awry. Russell makes it look awry. He camps deep in the crease and slugs it straight over Avesh's head
off-stump yorker, squirted into the leg side for another one
muscled down the ground. Smith runs across to his right from wide long-off to intercept the ball. Low full-toss outside off, cracked away. Both batters were ball-watching, so KKR get just one
low full-toss, slanting into middle, tucked away to fine leg
full and wide, thrashed through the line to the left of sweeper and right of wide long-off
just short of a yorker length outside off, Avesh still defeats Cummins outside off
Rabada hikes his pace to 144ks, but misses the yorker. Russell lines up this full-toss and whacks it over long-on for another six. Russell has got his strike rate past 150
pumped over Rabada's head for six. Length ball outside off at 125ks, Russell gives himself additional room and powers it down the ground
back of a length and skidding through the big swing of Russell at 143ks. Fine take from Pant behind the stumps
the attempted yorker comes out as a full-toss on middle. Russell lines it up and muscles it over the long leg-side boundary. Sent over midwicket for four
slower bouncer, Rabada takes it away from the reach of Russell who swings lustily to the leg side...and misses
full-toss on middle, heaved to deep midwicket
back of a length and angling down the leg side for a wide
Avesh nails the wide yorker this time. Russell reaches out for the ball and slices it down to deep third man
the attempted yorker comes out as a slot ball wide of off. Russell stays leg-side of the ball and smears it through the right of extra-cover and beats long-off to his left
misses the yorker this time, comes out as a middle-stump full-toss, which is swung away to deep square leg
Avesh nails another yorker outside off and goes under Cummins' bat. Top death bowling
yorker just a shade outside off, squeezes under Cummins' bat
pretty full on the pads with fine leg inside the circle, Cummins tucks it away fine of that infielder for four
fired into middle from left-arm around, Cummins can't get underneath the length. Hauled away to long-on
shorter and outside off, punched off the back foot again, this time to the left of Hetmyer at sweeper cover
shorter and just a shade outside off, punched back to the bowler
pushed through fuller on middle, driven back to the bowler

Karthik does not connect with a reverse-sweep and has been given out leg before by umpire Barde. Karthik has a chat with Russell and calls for a review. Axar drags his length back, thumps the back pad above the knee-roll in front of middle. No bat involved. Ball-tracking suggests it would've cannoned into middle. Three reds, so Karthik has to exit
Okay, Karthik steps into a higher gear. Pushed through full and outside off, drops down to one knee and muscles a slog-sweep to the midwicket fence
Karthik shimmies out, searches for the sweep, Ishant slips in a low full-toss, which is edged through the covers
short legcutter outside off, Karthik is too early into a back-foot pull and toe-ends it back to Ishant
low full-toss on off stump, Russell clears his front leg and hoicks it to long-on
wide yorker, squeezes underneath the swinging bat. Good comeback from Ishant
slow, slot ball on middle. Russell clears his front leg and clobbers it over the midwicket boundary. The cutter goes wrong for Ishant. This is the shorter side for Russell
full-toss on middle from over the wicket, whipped between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Russell gets to 6000 T20 runs on his 33rd birthday
slog-swept over midwicket. Pushed through, a bit wide of off, Karthik drops down to one knee and hauls it away against the intended turn. He clears the bigger boundary at Motera
Karthik jumps outside leg, then shuffles back in line, as the ball rolls off the thigh pad to short fine leg
slower and on off and middle, Russell stays leg-side of this too and punches a single to cover. Russell dawdles to 7 off 14
good length and angling into middle at 92ks, Karthik closes the bat-face and turns a single into the leg side
back of a length on middle, Russell stays leg-side of this dart and powers it to the left of Dhawan at long-off
on a length and sliding into off, played back to the bowler
slower ball, wide of off, slapped away to sweeper cover off the back foot
back of a length and bounces over middle stump at 146ks as Russell clears his front leg, swipes again and misses
Karthik gets on top of a short ball outside off and secures a single to deep third man
low full-toss on middle, shovelled away to the left of long-on with the bottom wrist. Lalit swoops down on the ball. He's an excellent outfielder
slower ball, running away outside off, dinked to deep third man
on a length and outside off, Karthik moves forward and punches through the line to mid-off

121ks slower offcutter on off stump, Gill looks to break free. He lofts it in the air, but can't manufacture his own pace, and holes out to Smith at long-on. Bouncer, yorker, slower variation - Avesh is showing his range
another middle-stump yorker, great execution from Avesh. Jammed out to mid-off
lifter from wide of the crease, Avesh forces Russell to duck underneath it
Gill backs away outside leg again, Avesh follows him again and gives him no room. Plinked down to long-on
back of a length and around off, Russell jumps back and jabs to the covers
Gill backs away outside leg, Avesh chases the moving batsman and hits a heavy length. Punched down the ground
middle-stump yorker, veering in from over the wicket. Russell brings his bat down in the nick of time and keeps it out
back of a length and outside off, Russell has a roundhouse swipe to the leg side...and misses
shortish and just a shade outside off, slower variation from Rabada, Gill delays the drive and tips it to cover
back of a length and veering into middle and leg, Gill spoons a leading edge in front of point
full-toss on off, 145ks, surprises Russell, flapped into the leg side
back of a length and outside off, punched on the up, bounces in front of Smith at mid-off. Gill has to run around the bowler. A direct hit could've got Gill
slider on outside off, Russell plays for the offbreak and is beaten on the outside edge. This is turning out to be an excellent spell from Lalit
arrowed into middle from over the wicket, defended from the crease

Narine has been castled for a duck. Quick offbreak from Lalit. Angling in from round the wicket, on a fullish length, Lalit finds just enough turn to beat the outside edge and hit off stump. Narine drives on the up and misses it altogether
low full-toss on middle, 99ks, picked away through the leg side

holes out to long-off. Smith runs across to his right, judges it well, and sends back Morgan. The KKR captain backs away outside leg, Lalit darts it into middle and leg from round the wicket. Morgan aims for the loft, doesn't get enough power behind it, and Smith makes that tumbling take look pretty easy
back of a length and dug into the pitch, forced off the back foot between wide long-on and deep midwicket
floats a wide full-toss, drilled through the line. Hetmyer throws himself to his right from extra-cover to intercept the ball
short and wide of off, chopped past the right of deep third man for a double
on a length and floated into the pads, diverted square through the leg side
carved straight in the air to Lalit at deep cover. Good length and pushed wide of Tripathi once again. He uses his feet, opens the bat-face, and picks out Lalit in the outfield
full and pushed wide of off, Tripathi has an almighty slash away from the body and sends a thick outside edge flying over short third man for four
Tripathi advances at Stoinis straightaway. The seamer takes it away from Tripathi's reach and defeats him outside off
short on middle and leg, 104.1ks, forced down to long-on off the back foot
hard-length offbreak, 105ks, punched from the stumps to deep midwicket.
full at the stumps, 101ks, pinged down to long-on
down the track and whipped wide of deep midwicket. Tripathi calls for the second and gets it rather easily in the end
back of a length and slid into middle, punched to wide long-on off the back foot
low full-toss on off, stroked to the left of Dhawan at long-off
clattered across the line for six. Pushed through on a length and outside off, Gill sizes it up and slog-sweeps lustily over midwicket
down the track and forced back off the inner half
short, flat, rushes Tripathi into a slog, mis-hit to long-on
shorter and wide of off, carved away to sweeper cover off the back foot
good length and sliding into middle, played back to Patel
on a length and angling in at off, down the track and struck past the outstretched left hand of Patel
dragged down at off stump, hauled away straight to Smith at long-on
on a length and spins back in at off, played back to Lalit
darted outside off, Gill secures another single to long-on
shorter and outside off, forced back to Lalit
tossed up outside off, Tripathi slices it off the front foot over Lalt's head
flat and fired into off stump, punched to Smith at long-on
a fuller delivery thuds into the pads as Gill tries to flick it through midwicket

just past Rabada's outstretched right hand!. Oh this is a splendid effort from the South African quick, running back and to his right from mid-on. It's a woeful mis-hit from Gill, running at Ishant and trying to loft him over the top. It's a fingertip thing. It really is a fingertip thing
steps out but Ishant follows him and makes sure the ball goes off the inside edge of the bat to deep square leg
punches a good length ball to mid-off and immediately sets off, which saves him from a direct hit from Steven Smith
right through the line! That's the sort of shot that gets an out of form batsman going. Gill sees the knuckle ball early, holds his shape well and drives superbly through extra cover
the angle into the pads makes Gill go for a whip over the top of midwicket. Doesn't get all of it so has to settle for a couple
wide of the crease, back of a length and outside off at 141ks, Tripathi jumps on top of the bounce and laces it through extra-cover. High-elbowed punch from Tripathi
down the track, Avesh cuts his pace to 123ks, forced down the ground by Gill
off-stump full-toss, which is driven back to the bowler
Tripathi jumps across off to meet this 141.3ks short ball, he can only flap a scoop/sweep to short fine leg
shorter and angling into him, flicked through backward square leg to Stoinis in the outfield
Gill steps out to him, Avesh pounds it on a heavy length and makes life difficult for the advancing batsman. Stabbed out to mid-off
another arm ball, fizzes in from left-arm around and thumps the pad
back of a length and held back outside off, check-driven to the right of extra-cover

Rana runs past the slider, Pant grabs the ball, and flips the bails off. Axar pulls his length back, gets it to angle away from the advancing batsman from wide of the crease, from left-arm around. Rana chucks his hands at the ball and misses. Pant does the rest behind the stumps
pushed through on middle at 95.4ks, non-turner, Rana drops down to one knee and reverse-sweeps it powerfully over backward point for six
speared into the pads, tickled away to short fine leg
arm ball, keeps coming into Gill, defended back to him
shortish and outside off, turned away to the right of Stoinis at midwicket off the back foot
on a fullish length and outside off, Gill is forward, gets closer to the pitch and plays it back to the left of the bowler
attacking intent from Gill! He dashes out of the crease, takes this length ball from outside off and crunnnnnches it to the left of Ishant and right of mid-of
chopped from a middle-stump line to point
tip and run into the covers. Slower ball from Ishant, Gill rotates the strike
fullish and running away outside off, Rana stretches out and drives nicely to the right of mid-off
back of a length and skidding across off stump, Rana steers down to deep third man
hip-high short ball outside off, probably the slower variation. Offcutter it is. Rana delays the pull and hauls it away to the left of mid-on
Rana feigns to step away outside leg, Rabada chases him with an inswinging yorker. Kept out
on a length and nipping away past the outside edge in the channel. A crease-bound Rana wafts and misses
pitched up and sliding across off at 141.2ks, Rana checks his drive and chips it wide of extra-cover
back of a length and angling into off, Gill flows forward and drives it to the right of mid-off
much fuller and slanting away outside off, Rana dinks it to point and yells "Noooo!" to Gill
good length and Ishant brings this back into Gill from over the wicket, whipped away through square leg
intent from Gill. He steps out at Ishant, the seamer drags his length back, tickled away off the hips to short fine leg
back of a length and on the hips, nearly picked away through square leg
shortish and largely holds its line outside off, Gill tips it to point and sets off for an urgent single. They take on Lalit's arm for the single
back of a length and on middle and leg, Rana bunts it through the vacant spaces at midwicket
really full on middle and leg, Stoinis has a big hoick at it and ends up inside-edging it through his legs to the fine-leg boundary
slower legcutter outside off, Stoinis swings lustily to the leg side and does not connect
short and outside off. Stoinis stays leg-side of the ball and slices it away to the right of sweeper cover
fullish and outside off, Hetmyer camps back and whips to midwicket
Pant finishes it off with a six. Holes out to Mavi at the long-on boundary. On a length and outside off, it was in Pant's slot. He lofts, but can't clear the outfielder
overpitched and outside off, Pant's weight is on the back foot, but the hands do all the work. Cracked hard through the covers

Cummins and Karthik appeal for a catch behind the wicket. Umpire Barde shakes his head. Morgan calls for a review. Cummins pounds it on a hard length and gets it to kick away outside off. Pant chucks his hands at the ball. Did that bounce over his bat? Yes. Good decision from Barde

Top-edged in the air and taken at point. Shaw shuffles outside leg, manufactures swinging room, but Cummins bangs a lifter that follows the moving batsman. Spliced in the air. It swerves away from Rana, but he gets into a side-on position and hangs onto this skier. Shaw is warmly welcomed back by his team-mates and Ponting
dug in short and angling into the body of Shaw. Fended back to Cummins
slower ball on leg stump, Pant delays his drive and quietly plays it back to Krishna
banged in short at Pant's throat, he swivels on the back foot and splices a pull over long leg for six
length ball on middle, Krishna lands it in the swinging arc of Pant. He muscles it away to the midwicket boundary
short at the body, helped away through square leg for a double
Shaw shuffles a fair away across off and searches for the scoop. Krishna aims for a yorker, but ends up firing a full-toss down the leg side
on-pace bouncer, Shaw ducks under it. The no-ball siren goes off. Krishna has to re-bowl it. Morgan has a wry smile on his face
slower bouncer outside off from Krishna, Shaw ramps.. and misses
full and slanting into off and middle, Pant plays it back to Cummins

Dhawan misses a low full-toss sliding into him from round the wicket. Trapped bang in front. Dhawan shuffles across off and doesn't connect with a flick. It would've crashed into the middle of middle stump. Some respite for KKR and their fans
Dhawan uses his feet and flays a short ball from outside off to backward point. Sprawling save in the infield
Dhawan shuffles across off, gets into the short of this short ball angling into his body, and helps it over square leg with a pull.
Shaw gets on top of a short ball outside off and punches strongly to sweeper cover
short and on the hips, tucked away to deep square leg
Shaw stays leg-side of this short ball outside off and cracks it hard to sweeper cover
leg-side wide from Narine
short on the pads, whipped through backward square leg off the back foot
darted into the pads from round the wicket, Dhawan misses the flick
Shaw uses his feet, Narine drags his length back outside off, punched back to him as he lets it pop out of his hands
shorter and drifts away outside off, chopped to point
rank long-hop on middle stump, Shaw lines it up and pummels a pull over midwicket for a flat six
dropped short and spins away from Shaw, this legbreak is forced off the back foot to sweeper cover
dropped shorter and spins away outside off, cracked off the back foot to the right of sweeper cover
and Shaw punches it straighter to long-off
short and fired wide of off, chopped off the back foot to sweeper cover
leg-side wide from Varun as this ball spins down the leg side. Dhawan topples over the flick and Karthik takes the bails off but Dhawan's back foot is anchored
on a fuller length and spins away outside off, guided to point
short and skids across off stump, Dhawan latches onto the width and cuts it firmly between backward point and short third man
slower through the air on middle, tip and run to cover
hauled away to deep midwicket with a slog-sweep
tossed up on middle and leg, worked away through square leg
half-tracker on middle stump, Shaw uses the depth of the crease and pulls it flat and hard to the midwicket boundary
slower offbreak wide of off, Dhawan top-edges a sweep in the air. Lands well in front of long leg
googly, short and wide of off, Dhawan cracks it to sweeper cover off the back foot
Shaw shimmies out and hauls it in the air. Lands in front of long-on
lashed down to long-off
powered along the ground to long-off

Dropped by Gill. He parries it over the long-off boundary for six. Shaw ventures down the track and drills it down the ground. Gill leaps at the edge of the fence, but the ball bursts through his hands. Varun has his hands on his mouth
flat and quick outside off, Dhawan slashes and almost plays on
dragged down on middle stump, Dhawan rocks into a back foot pull and hits the ball to deep midwicket
back of a length and spins into middle, clipped firmly to deep square leg
hauled away from outside off to long leg with a sweep
dropped short and wide, slashed straight to point once again
darted wide of off, Dhawan leans back and chops to the right of point
knuckle ball, floated into middle, Dhawan plays back and pushes towards midwicket
short and slanting into the body, blocked towards mid-on off the back foot
Cummins bangs a bouncer, Shaw ducks under it and lets it sail through to Karthik
and there he goes with an high-elbowed punch over mid-off. Fullish and around off, put away in grand style by Shaw
squeezed to mid-on off the inner half
back of a length and outside off, Dhawan uses the pace of Cummins to his advantage and glides it fine of deep third man for four
good length on middle and leg at 141ks, tucked away to deep square leg. Shaw notches up an 18-ball half-century - the joint-fastest for DC
length outside off, cuts it to point
back of a length, sticks in the pitch a bit, Dhawan looking to cut it gets an under-edge
too short, he opens his stance up and whacks a pull shot to deep midwicket, where Tripathi has to run to his right and slide to stop it
gets room to punch it outside off and connects sweetly, but it's outside the powerplay so KKR have some protection on the boundary
length outside off, punched to long-off
length outside off, tries to cut it away, thick edge goes on the bounce to short third man.
anti climax. Bouncer on middle and Shaw ducks under. Didn't know he was legally allowed to not whack the ball during this innings.
length ball into him, flicked to square leg
cramping him for room again, full and into him, Dhawan's looking to nurdle it away, but can't beat midwicket
angling into him again, Dhawan's looking to steer it to third man, but gets an inside edge that bounces down near boot
length ball angling into him, pushed into the offside
length outside off, steered to point

he can do anything and it'll come off. Back of a length ball that is outside off, and he half-carves it, half hangs his bat a bit, the ball just zooms off through backward point. In the air but no fielder there and he finds another boundary.
back of a length going across him, opens the face and steers through point. There's a fielder back there to clean up
back of a length, cramping him up, Dhawan looks to pull but gets an under-edge that drops near him. Wants the single but is sent back, wisely so
length ball, stump to stump, tucked to midwicket
a bit too early into the attempted flick to this full ball on middle, and he gets a leading edge that rolls towards mid-off
hello, says Shikhar Dhawan, I'm here to hit boundaries too. Overpitched outside off and he leans into a pristine cover drive that pierces the gap and purrs all the way to the boundary
soft hands used to turn it through midwicket. The fielder is deep and the batsmen are alive to the second.
wider outside off again, he comes on the front foot and uses the room to flay it over cover, two bounces into the boundary. He's toying with the bowling, is Shaw

tossed up wider outside off, making him reach for it, but that doesn't matter to Shaw in this form. He slices it over extra cover and all the way. Stunning. He's going at a strike rate of over 300 and that's his first six.
angled into him and flicked off his pads through midwicket
length outside off, punched to cover.
length ball coming into him, gently nudged through midwicket. They think about a second but decide against it
shorter and angling across off, played to point with an open bat-face
pitched up and angling across off, Dhawan slices a drive to the right of sweeper
on a length and seams away past the outside edge
back of a length and angling across off, driven to the left of sweeper cover
Krishna shortens his length and gets it closer to off, defended back to him
overpitched and outside off, angling away further. Dhawan leans into it and eases it away through extra-cover
tossed up slower and higher on off, sliced in the air to the right of mid-off
good length and spinning into middle and leg, clipped through square leg
fractionally short and outside off, Shaw stays leg-side of the ball and crunnnnches it between point and extra-cover
pushed through on middle and leg, non-turner, which is nurdled through square leg
fired down the leg side, wide
back of a length and on the legs, punched down to long-on
pushed through fuller and sliding into middle and leg, worked off the back foot through midwicket
Six successive fours for Shaw. This is not a half-volley. On a length and outside off, hit over the top once again. Driven strongly over extra-cover
Make that five fours in a row for Shaw. He sizes up this short ball outside off and scythes it away through backward point. Mavi looks rattled. Morgan has a chat with the young seamer
low full-toss outside off, Shaw leans into this slower ball, delays the drive, and steers it away to the right of sweeper once again. Four fours on the trot for Shaw
overpitched and outside off, Shaw drills a drive through the line. Stroked to the right of sweeper
another inswinger, too full, too straight. Shaw picks it up and whips it with the wrists over midwicket for back-to-back fours
pumped over Mavi's head. Pitched up and swings in at off, it lands in Shaw's arc. He brings out a high-elbowed punch
very full and veering down the leg side. Karthik dives full-length to his left and plucks the ball out with one hand
